summary:
Trello is the board tool at trello.com, now part of Atlassian. The blue-and-white tab icon is what board bookmarks use, separate from the Atlassian corporate favicon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against trello.com. HTML came from https://trello.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.trello.com/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://trello.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 2710 bytes. Directory sizes: 256×256.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #1155bb comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-256x256-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 2688 bytes) from https://trello.com/favicon.ico.

files.dimensionNote: PNG payload inside the ICO. Not resized.
